wishes.name: Anoma & Mahinda Perera
wishes.message: Gayashan, you have always carried our house with a quiet strength. Vishmi, you walked in and made that strength feel like warmth. May your home be patient, your table full, and your days kind to one another.

wishes.name: Chamari & Rohan Fernando
wishes.message: Vishmi, our joy has a new name now — and it is this life you begin with Gayashan. We bless the gentleness between you. Go forward as partners, and know two families stand behind you as one.

wishes.name: Kasun Perera
wishes.message: I have watched this friendship become a promise. May you keep the laughter you already have, and find even more of it in the ordinary mornings ahead.
